citations.desc: Institutional Animal Care and Use Committee (IACUC).
citations.narrative:
The Institutional Animal Care and Use Committee (IACUC) conducted a semi-annual review of its animal care and use
program and animal facility inspection on April 2, 2026. However, the IACUC failed to prepare and submit a report signed
by a majority of the IACUC members to the Institutional Official (IO) as required.
Reports completed by the IACUC ensure the Institutional Official is informed and up to date regarding the current status of
the animal program, facilities, and procedures. The IACUC must prepare reports of its evaluations and submit them to the
IO of the research facility. The reports shall be reviewed and signed by a majority of the IACUC members and must
include any minority views.
To be corrected from this date forward

citations.desc: Attending veterinarian and adequate veterinary care.
citations.narrative:
At the time of inspection on August 11, 2026, there was an open, punctured bottle of xylazine, a sedative, that had
expired in September 2025 in the medication tote being used by animal health staff. The expired bottle of
anesthetic/analgesic was commingled with other medications for use during study procedures and not labeled as expired.
The use of expired medications does not meet acceptable standards of veterinary practice, and their usage may not be
safe nor efficacious. It is the responsibility of the research facility to ensure that the use of appropriate methods to
prevent, control, and treat diseases and injuries are utilized in order to maintain the health and well-being of the animals
as set forth in this section.
To be corrected from this date forward.
This inspection and exit interview were conducted with a facility representative.
